gaps.detail: Independent Windows .NET backends required for DMI/CPU/USB, HID/serial, input ownership/virtual outputs, sensors, power/fan/battery. sysfs, evdev, uinput, IIO, powercap, hwmon, acpi_call and kernel firmware attributes are Linux mechanisms.
Battery threshold/bypass and generic fans/RGB discovered at runtime. Do not infer model capability from generic backend code.
HPPAC, G1617-02-L, G1622-01/-L, G1628-04/-L remain literal power identifiers; source does not authoritatively map marketing names or aliases. Cross-check higher-priority HC.

Profiles are not a complete CPU/year/SKU catalogue. Keep raw DMI aliases and editions. Zeenix/Loki share mapping but detector does not independently prove rebrand relationship. Shared AOKZOE/OXP display names must not merge models.
OrangePi G1621-02 commented out; forced Claw references absent CONFS[MS]. Neither is an additional active model.

No hardware, firmware compatibility, Windows runtime, actual axis/button mapping, controller transitions, sleep/resume or safe power/fan acceptance performed. Static implementation is not runtime proof.

sharedMechanisms.mechanism: hwmon providers oxp_ec, gpdfan, ayaneo_ec, thinkpad; legacy oxpec. thinkpad requires thinkpad_acpi fan_control enabled. Need PWM + enable endpoints; temperatures from amdgpu/k10temp/coretemp.

sharedMechanisms.scope: Runtime provider range; opt-in next backend
sharedMechanisms.mechanism: Known platform-profile provider prefixes amd-dptc, lenovo-wmi-gamezone, asus-wmi, thinkpad-acpi-profile, samsung-galaxybook; choices intersect supported profiles. No model inventory inferred from provider name. Custom TDP attributes only amd-dptc/lenovo-wmi-other.
charge_control_end_threshold, charge_types with BypassS0/Bypass/Long_Life, charge_behaviour inhibit-charge; legacy charge_type bypass restricted to ONE-NETBOOK sys_vendor.
sharedMechanisms.windowsImplementation: Independent OEM charging implementation required; generic Windows battery APIs do not establish vendor charge writes.

sharedMechanisms.mechanism: sysfs LED names containing multicolor:chassis or :rgb:joystick_rings, solid/disabled source path.
Power-profiles-daemon DBus UPower PowerProfiles via busctl; policy profile selection only, not numerical TDP. Power-button plugin registers without any model matcher.
sharedMechanisms.windowsImplementation: Independent Windows power policy/button integration, no model capability claim.
